recent_alerts.text:
🚨 Bench Jaylen Brown, start Paul George in G slot before 08:30 KST

Brown (knee) is doubtful for tonight's Knicks game, and his tip-off is Sat 08:30 KST, about 2 hours away. Doubtful usually means he sits, so start a bench option who plays the same night: Paul George (BOS, 2 games left) or Payton Pritchard (BOS, 2 games left). Both have 2 games left, so either is a reasonable swap.

Lock: make the change before 08:30 KST Sat. No add needed, so you keep your last add.

Karl-Anthony Towns (wrist) is probable, so keep him in PF. No change there.

⚠️ Check Jaylen Brown before Sun 07:00 KST

Brown (G) was ruled out for Friday's game. His next game is Sun 07:00 KST, and his status for that game isn't confirmed yet. Brown has 1 game left this week.
If he's still out

⚠️ Castle (migraine) is questionable: check before 09:00 KST

- Stephon Castle (Util) is listed Day-To-Day for Saturday's game (Sun 09:00 KST, his only game left this week).
- Devin Vassell (SAS, Util) plays the same game, so Util is covered if Castle sits.
- If Castle is ruled out, you could move Pritchard or George (both BOS, each 1 game, Mon 05:30 KST) into a starting slot. Those are your only healthy bench options with games left.
- Ty Jerome (back, DTD) also tips at 09:00

🏀 Final day of the week: only Pritchard and George play. Start both before 05:30 KST.

First tip: BOS@ORL, Mon 05:30 KST (the lineup locks then). Last game is TOR@LA

🏀 Pre-tip: only Giannis plays tonight. First tip is 11:00 KST (ORL@PHX).

- Giannis (MIA, PF) is the only one of your players in action, in MIA@GS at 12:00 KST. He's in your active PF slot and has no injury tag, so leave him there. Lineup locks at 12:00 KST.
- Jalen Suggs (ORL) plays at 11:00 KST but is Out (knee bone bruise, re-evaluate in about 2 weeks). Keep him on IL.
- Nobody else on your roster has a game tonight, so there are no bench swaps to make.
- Watson (CLE), Jalen Johnson (ATL) and Pritchard (BOS) are all questionable, but for Friday Pacific games. Those tip Sat 09:00-09:30 KST, not tonight. They're all on your bench, so nothing is at risk right now. Recheck status before Sat 09:00 KST.
- Zubac is on IL with no injury tag in my data. Confirm in the app that he's still marked Out, since a healthy player on IL can block adds.

🔄 Start Peyton Watson over Ty Jerome in Util

Watson is now healthy and has 1 game left (Sun 10:00 KST). Ty Jerome has 0 games left this week, so his Util spot is wasted.

Move: Bench Jerome, start Watson in Util. No add used (6 left).

Deadline: before Watson's tip-off, Sun 10:00 KST.

🔀 Start Jalen Johnson, bench Ty Jerome

ESPN now lists Johnson as healthy. He's on your bench with a game Sun 09:30 KST.
Swap him into Util for Ty Jerome, who has 0 games left this week, so you lose nothing.
Make the change before Johnson's tip-off at 09:30 KST. No add needed; 6 adds remain.

🚨 Paul George is out, so move him to IL and start a bench player

- George (illness) is ruled out for tonight's game vs Toronto, which tips Thu 09:00 KST. He's still in your active SF slot, so that spot scores nothing.
- Move him to the one open IL spot and start Payton Pritchard (BOS, plays Thu 09:00) or another bench player who fits SF/Util. Check eligibility in the app.
- Karl-Anthony Towns (calf, day-to-day) is questionable for Thu 09:00 KST. Decide before tip-off whether to keep him in F or swap in Peyton Watson or Matas Buzelis.
- Ajay M

🚨 Move Ajay Mitchell off IL to an active spot

He's now Day-To-Day (left ankle sprain), not Out. He's already ruled out for Wed (Pacific), but he can't stay in an IL slot. Yahoo may flag that, and it could block adds.
Move him to BN or Util before his next game, Sat 12:30 KST.
Don't drop anyone. One IL slot is empty either way.
Adds: 4 left this week, pending Yahoo confirmation.
